rics.description: Indonesia, EMISSIONS - CARBON DIOXIDE, Volume, Commodity Fundamentals, Annual, British Petroleum
rics.meaning: Indonesia, Emissions — Carbon Dioxide — annual CO2 emissions volume. Indonesia is the world's ~10th largest emitter, with significant share from deforestation + coal power.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks emissions trajectory under Indonesia's NDC (Nationally Determined Contributions) commitments. Net-zero target 2060. Coal-power phase-out is the major decarbonization variable.
